name: Asylum Sanctorium
summary: The Asylum Sanctorium is a mini trial found within the Reactor District in the Brass Fortress. You will receive a Radiance Resonator with your other rewards after defeating Saint Olms with hard mode engaged.

achievements.name: Asylum Sanctorium Redeemer
achievements.description: Complete the listed achievements for Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Asylum Sanctorium Conqueror
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Asylum Sanctorium Vanquisher
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold in the same fight in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Righteous Condemnation
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just and Saint Llothis the Pious in the same battle in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Perfect Purification
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold in the same battle without suffering a group member death within 15 minutes of entering the Sanctuary Atrium in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Asylum Sanctorium Completed
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold in Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Asylum Sanctorium Contender
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold in the same fight in Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Sanctified
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold without suffering a group member death in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Swift Mercy
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold within a time limit of 15 minutes in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium. Timer starts when players enter the Sanctuary Atrium.

achievements.name: Beatific Beatdown
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Olms the Just, Saint Llothis the Pious, and Saint Felms the Bold at the same time without allowing Saint Felms or Saint Llothis to enrage during the fight.

achievements.name: Imperfect Attendance
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Llothis the Pious without dismantling his Imperfect Attendants in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

achievements.name: Placid Projections
achievements.description: Defeat Saint Felms the Bold without allowing either of his Pneuma Projections to enrage in Veteran Asylum Sanctorium.

notes: You will receive a Radiance Resonator for completing the trial on Hard Mode.
